description: This file contains the GeoWorker class, which provides static utility methods for handling geographical data, such as expanding geographic groups and regions, and retrieving geographic points within a Java-based project using the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GeoWorker
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to perform various geographic data operations such as expanding geo groups, regions, and fetching latest geographic points.

methods.name: expandGeoGroup
methods.description: Expands a geo group identified by geoId or a GenericValue to a list of constituent geos, resolving nested group memberships.

methods.name: expandGeoRegionDeep
methods.description: Recursively expands geographic regions into more detailed subdivisions based on geo associations.

methods.name: containsGeo
methods.description: Checks if a specific geoId or GenericValue exists within a list of geo values.

methods.name: findLatestGeoPoint
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent geographic point for an entity based on date ordering, with optional secondary identifiers.

methods.name: getMeasurementSystem
methods.description: Determines whether the locale uses Imperial or Metric measurement system.
